description: Genuine, statute-accurate employment-law calculator: a single generic component renders any of the 5 calculators from a data-driven field/aside schema and dispatches to a pure calc function (holidayPay/ssp/feriepenger/semesterdagar/vuosiloma), each citing the specific statute section behind every computed row. Not a decorative mock — real formulas including UK WTR reference-period logic, Norway's 6G cap, Sweden's sammalöneregeln/procentregeln split, and Finland's 2.0-vs-2.5-day accrual test.

conditionalOn.note: field-group visibility can depend on another field's value

citation.note: real statute citation, e.g. 'WTR reg 16(3)(e)' — must not be fabricated, see document.regulatory-prose assetRole

exampleDataButton.note: UK holiday-pay calculator has a 'load example data' button for a 55-week table

motion.reducedMotionFallback: n/a — this is a functional form, not an animated element

note: This is a real interactive feature, not a mock illustration. A generator producing a PageSpec for this section must not substitute a static image — the field schema and calc dispatch must remain functional.
